About

RAVIVARMA Writer & Director

Ravivarma Pachaiappan is the creative force behind Wildframe Films — a Chennai-based ad film production house built on the belief that every brand has a story worth telling on screen.

With a background that spans feature film direction, screenwriting, and dialogue writing, Ravivarma brings a cinematic sensibility to every commercial he helms. He has directed a feature film starring legendary Tamil comedy king Goundamani — a depth of storytelling that sets Wildframe apart from conventional ad film studios.

From television commercials to digital campaigns and corporate films, Wildframe delivers work that is not just seen — but felt.

Featured the legendary Goundamani in our debut feature film — bringing decades of Tamil cinema craft to every frame we shoot.

OUR
SERVICES.

TV Commercials

High-impact television ads crafted to capture attention in seconds. From script to screen, we handle the full production with a cinematic edge that makes your brand unforgettable on air.

02

Digital Ad Films

Content built for the digital world — social media, YouTube, OTT platforms. Shareable, scroll-stopping films that connect your brand with today's audiences where they actually watch.

03

Corporate Films

Brand stories, product launches, company profiles — presented with clarity and cinematic quality. We help businesses communicate their vision with the power and precision of film.
